_notes: 544-bed acute care, Pasadena. Affiliated with Cedars-Sinai Aug 2021 — operates with own board/employees but resource sharing. Most recent direct rating data is 2018 S&P 'A-' affirmation on series 2014 bonds. Cedars-Sinai itself Aa3/stable (Moody's). Window data sparse — primary rating actions may not have occurred or are paywalled.
